summary: Solana university hackathon (27-29 Nov), online or at local build stations, preceded by a free Solana Rust bootcamp. Top teams invited to the Bridge Accelerator.
eligibility: University students worldwide, building in teams on Solana; projects must be open source.
title: Dev3pack Global Hackathon 2026

prize.description: US$10,000+ for Best App Overall on Solana; Seeker phones for best mobile app; US$500 local tracks in selected countries.

notes: Registration and cutoff time not confirmed on the organiser's own page; verify before applying.
